whyUs.headline: The Naresh Moto Advantage
whyUs.subhead: We believe motorcycle repair should be honest, transparent, and built to last on Nepal roads.
whyUs.card1Desc: We exclusively source factory-sealed OEM parts from Hero, Bajaj, Honda, Yamaha, and TVS with holograms.
whyUs.card2Desc: No surprise bills. We inspect first, explain what is worn out, and get your approval before starting.
whyUs.card3Desc: Drop your motorcycle off at 6 AM on your way to work and pick it up running smoothly by evening.
whyUs.card4Desc: Certified hands with over a decade of hands-on experience diagnosing 2-stroke and 4-stroke engines.
whyUs.card5Desc: 90% of routine periodic services and minor adjustments are completed within 45 to 60 minutes.
whyUs.card6Desc: High-standard dealership quality workmanship at honest local neighborhood garage pricing.

howItWorks.headline: How It Works
howItWorks.subhead: From drop-off to handover, our 4-step workflow guarantees complete peace of mind.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Schedule a guaranteed slot online or ride directly into our workshop at Dhore Pakahamainpur.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Master mechanic Naresh inspects engine, brakes, chain, electricals, and tire wear in front of you.
howItWorks.step3Desc: We explain required work and cost upfront. Only genuine parts are installed upon your approval.
howItWorks.step4Desc: We test ride the machine to ensure factory smoothness before you roll back onto Dhore roads.

aboutTeam.headline: Built on Honest Mechanical Craftsmanship & Local Trust.
aboutTeam.subhead: Two-wheelers are the lifeline of Dhore and Madhesh Province. We keep them running safely every day.
aboutTeam.storyP1: Two-wheelers are the lifeline of Dhore and Madhesh Province. Whether you are commuting to the customs border, traveling through dusty agricultural roads, or carrying daily loads, a reliable motorcycle is essential.
aboutTeam.storyP2: At Naresh Moto Repair Center, we started with a straightforward promise: diagnose problems accurately, tell the owner the truth about what is worn out, use genuine factory-sealed parts, and charge fair local rates.
aboutTeam.zeroDuplicatesDesc: We refuse to install cheap duplicate parts that fail after a few weeks.
aboutTeam.communityFirstDesc: We open early at 6 AM so local commuters never miss a day of work.
